description: Accessible, dependency-free React JSON tree viewer with bounded safe inspection, search, clipboard controls, and optional virtualization.
rules: Import JsonViewer from view-json-react, VirtualJsonViewer from view-json-react/virtual, and headless utilities from view-json-react/headless.
Import view-json-react/styles.css once; the package does not inject runtime styles.
Treat the viewer as read-only and pass untrusted or non-JSON values through its bounded inspection APIs rather than invoking accessors.
Preserve typed paths: object keys are strings, array indexes are numbers, and rootName is display-only.
Use the virtual entry only for large expanded datasets so ordinary consumers do not pay for windowing code.
